bootstrap.common_weights: identical calendar blocks across both branches and all cells

classes.high_adverse: max completed MAE across branches; ties timestamp,event_id
classes.rejected: earliest directed technical candidate not accepted; ties timestamp,touch_mode,signal_idx
classes.censored: earliest H15 censored event; ties timestamp,event_id
classes.unresolved: earliest episode with first_fast_in_development true, strictly_later_slow_contact null and same_bar_slow_contact false; ties first fast timestamp,event_id,shared_episode_id
classes.same_bar: earliest scoped first-fast/first-slow same-bar accepted pair
classes.different_time: earliest scoped first-fast/first-slow different times, either ordering; ties first timestamp,first ID,second ID,shared ID

example_selection.pair_windows: two separate capped windows, explicit omitted gap; max52 rows before dedup

scope: 2018–2020 New York signal-open development only; 2017 causal warmup

secondary_comparison_scope.episode_matching: retrospective first-accepted pairs; both events scoped and completed; no primary filtering

shared_episode.departure_after_non_departure: new ID and closes preceding observed episode
shared_episode.first_accepted: full causal history; never replace warmup first counterpart
shared_episode.pair_outcome_scope: both selected first events NY2018–2020 and complete at requested horizon
shared_episode.geometry_scope: finite usable valid mapped range/EMAs; equality geometry remains defined
shared_episode.contact_scope: scoped first fast only; same-bar and strictly-later geometric contact and accepted signal separately
shared_episode.absent_contact: false only fully observed new-departure closure; missing/reset/endpoint yields null/unresolved
shared_episode.outside_scope_first_fast: null descriptors; causal counterpart metadata retained

union_representative: slow if dual accepted; otherwise sole accepted member; source_event_id retained; same-bar scientific equality required
